changelog: BIM-Bot v2.4.0 — Strict any-machine install. New installer/Install-Prerequisites.ps1 checks and auto-downloads every missing runtime (.NET 8 Desktop, WebView2, VC++ Redist via winget with direct-download fallback). Non-admin installer hardened: UTF-8-no-BOM writes (Claude rejected BOM files), bundled-Node-first resolution (GUI Claude cannot resolve bare 'node'), installed-vs-dev server path detection, MS-Store config path (AnthropicClaude*), backup + quarantine instead of wiping other MCP servers, shadow-manifest cleanup, and post-write verification. Revit side: no-document 'ping' command plus scripts/probe-revit.cjs for a true Link-2 round-trip test, so 'Claude green but Revit stopped' is diagnosable in seconds.
